latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image Animation Generator

- Converts static images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into 1080p animated MP4 videos in 20–40 seconds.
- Connects seamlessly to a cloud GPU backend; provides status updates during processing.
- Supports easy image upload and simple text prompts for animation and video options.
- Handles multiple image and audio formats; offers credit management for both anonymous and registered users.
- Provides error handling for authentication, credits, file support, and rate limits.
- Organized workflows for batch processing, quick edits, and iterative refinements.
